title: Three console faces format dates in the UI language rather than the display locale: marketplace `installedAt`, marketplace relative time, and the cloud-connection `bound_at`
body:
Filing gate: class (b), a declared contract violated. Surfaced by the objectui#10232 dev (`os-dev-report` 5819505192, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`. ⛔ Unlabelled: `domain:*`, type and priority belong to triage.

## What (relayed from the dev, at objectui `8b1f06619`; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

| face | expression |
|:--|:--|
| `InstalledListWidget` (marketplace installed date) | `toLocaleString(language \|\| undefined)`. It falls back to the **machine** locale when `language` is empty |
| `MarketplacePage` (relative time) | `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(language \|\| 'en')` |
| `CloudConnectionPanel` (`bound_at`) | `toLocaleString(language)` |

All three format with the **UI language**, not the display locale. A regional locale (e.g. `de-CH` numbers and dates under an English UI) is ignored on these faces.

## Contract

`packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts`: 「Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason.」

`Seam: i18n:useDisplayLocale doc contract → renderer:InstalledListWidget / MarketplacePage / CloudConnectionPanel`

## Why the objectui#9909 census misses them

The census flags bare, `undefined` and literal-tag call sites. These faces pass an expression (`language`), which the census cannot resolve.

## Dedupe

The search API is refused. Instead, a REST listing of 624 objectui issues (open, plus the most recently updated closed) was matched on the three component names plus `locale`: the only hit is PR objectui#10231 (closed; it is the objectui#9909 census work that scoped these out). Dedupe words: `marketplace installedAt locale language` · `useObjectTranslation language Intl display locale` · `CloudConnectionPanel bound_at toLocaleString`.
